Monsoon Weakens in Parts of India, Heat and Humidity Rise

Following a brief period of heavy rainfall, the monsoon has weakened in parts of Uttar Pradesh and Chhattisgarh. This has led to a resurgence of heat and humidity in affected areas, with expectations of continued dry weather for several days. The shift in weather patterns is causing discomfort and altering local climate conditions.
